name: Grave Keeper
description: Find your tombstone and bring its items back from a distance: /grave.where says how far and which way, /grave.claim sends its stacks to you (within a range, after a cooldown, at an optional cost). Only your own: the tombstone that appears where you died. Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. A Lua mod. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Players may claim their tombstone
settings.help: Off: /grave.where still finds it; the items have to be fetched.

settings.label: Claim within (m)
settings.help: 0 = from anywhere (where the game has the place loaded).

settings.label: Between claims (minutes)
settings.help: Per player, minutes of play; only claims that brought something count.

settings.label: Cost: item
settings.help: An item's debug name (items rune in the console), empty = free. Given back if nothing came.

settings.label: Tombstones kept per player
settings.help: The newest; /grave.claim takes the newest one that is loaded.

settings.label: Show where your tombstone is
settings.help: The host's own; players who joined use /grave.where.
